

# Shafiqullah Yousafzai, Ph.D.

## International Trade • Development Economics • Spatial Economics

I am a researcher in international trade, development economics, spatial economics, and economic geography. My research focuses on international trade, market access, regional inequality, household welfare, and applied econometrics.

## Research Interests

-   International Trade
-   Development Economics
-   Spatial Economics
-   Economic Geography
-   Applied Econometrics
-   Agricultural Economics

## Current Research

-   Trade Hubs and Regional Inequality
-   Exchange Rate Volatility and Export Growth
-   Trade and Child Labor
-   Trade and Infant Mortality
-   Technical Efficiency of Wheat Production
-   High-Speed Rail and NO₂ Emissions
-   Road Quality and Trade Integration
